A home that comes with its own park.
3 Bed 3 Bath 1,549 Sq Ft 2-Car Garage Built 2019
Step outside your front door and you’re not staring at a parking lot or your neighbor’s fence — you’re stepping directly into one of Longmont’s most thoughtfully designed community parks. Morning coffee out here hits differently when there’s actual grass, actual trees, and actual quiet.

Inside, the living room opens up around you — open concept, natural light, and a gas fireplace for a Friday night in. And then there’s the kitchen — open, flowing, the center of things. Head upstairs to the primary suite, or set up at the top of the stairs in the extra space — a proper spot that makes working from home feel like something you designed on purpose.

Boulder is twenty minutes down the Diagonal. You already know if this is your place. Come see it anyway — just to be sure.
